name: matt-implement-adapter
description: Runs multi-ticket Matt implement work with one fresh isolated Codex subagent per ticket and dependency-ordered integration.

interface.shortDescription: Fresh Codex context and commit for every Matt ticket.
interface.longDescription: Adapts Matt's multi-ticket implement flow to Codex by running each approved implementation ticket in a fresh isolated worktree and subagent. Independent tickets may run in parallel; the parent integrates them in dependency order, handles conflicts and shared test resources, runs integration checks, and cleans up completed branches.
defaultPrompt: Implement the approved tickets in isolated worktrees, parallelize independent tickets, and integrate them in dependency order.
